tasks.task: Run the weekly account review and call each ad

items.when: Once a week on the same day, plus a quick mid-week look at spend and rejections
When the weekly export is in and each ad needs a pause, keep or scale call
Each week, to turn the exports into keep, fix or kill calls with reasons
When test numbers are small, to check each call against sample size and the kill rule
When you have view counts and want each video placed by how it hooks and holds
When TikTok reports a high return, to test it against the shop's own totals

tasks.task: Plan a TikTok campaign with a test and a scale phase

items.when: When a client needs objectives, structure, budgets and rules for test and scale
When you want a second layout from the budget and target cost to compare
Before any budget is set, to work out the cost per order the margin can bear
When you need the test budget, the days to run and the keep or cut rule
When the plan must say how many new videos are needed each week
When the plan bets big on a guess, to shrink it to a small test that proves the claim

tasks.task: Run new client intake before touching Ads Manager

items.when: In the first conversation, to collect the facts every later decision depends on
When product facts are scattered, to put them in one file every later step reads
When the client says the account is set up, to find the missing steps
When the client has no target cost, to work one out from price and margin

tasks.task: Launch a first campaign or rebuild after costs climbed

items.when: For a first campaign, a new product or market, or a rebuild after costs climbed
When you want a second launch run with a setup fix list and a first test read-out
Before launch, to get the client's yes to the one-time action list
Before money is spent, to score the setup and list what is missing
When ads are loaded, to find issues against the approved facts and audience

tasks.task: Set up and check the pixel and conversion events

items.when: When sales or leads from ads are missing or doubled and tracking needs repair
Each month, to catch tracking that broke after a site or checkout change
When you must confirm the pixel and events are in place before a launch

tasks.task: Plan the next round of hook and format tests

items.when: When each test must change one thing and have a kill rule before it starts
When tests need named hooks, a dated log and rules set before launch
When you need hooks from five different tactics, ranked by buyer fit and proof
When you want ten more openings checked for length and reading level
When past winners exist, to build a rubric from them and score new drafts
Before filming, to score each hook for this audience and rewrite the weak ones

tasks.task: Write short ad scripts for creators

items.when: When a creator needs a 15 to 30 second script to film in their own voice
When the script should follow five parts from hook to call to action with timings
When you want a selfie-style version built on the buyer's main doubt to compare
When reviews are strong, to try a script where every line comes from a customer
When a script is drafted, to find where it starts selling too early
When the script reads like an advert, to put it in the way a person really talks

tasks.task: Write a Spark Ads creator brief and approval process

items.when: When a creator's post will run as an ad and brief, approvals and access must be clear
When the script is approved and the creator needs a filming brief and shoot order
When posts already exist and you must pick which to boost as Spark Ads
When the brand's own organic post did well and should be promoted as an ad
Before the post is authorised as an ad, to check claims, disclosure and consent

tasks.task: Find creators, build a roster and set fair pay

items.when: When you need a gifting funnel, roster size and a pay rule for creator ads
When you must find creators, decide what to offer and how to approach them
When you need a fair flat fee or a floor plus commission for one creator post
Before a deal, to check who the creator's audience is and whether it fits

tasks.task: Develop a batch of ad concepts and angles

items.when: When you need concepts from seven different groups with the best eight ranked
When one idea works and you want 10 to 15 other angles on it with hooks
When you have reviews, to map personas, angles and offers in the order to test
When the account repeats itself, to map gaps and get five ideas not yet tried
When concepts are chosen, to check each test changes one thing and has a kill rule
When every concept is a feature list, to find one true, simple idea

tasks.task: Catch tired ads early and refresh the winners

items.when: Twice a week, to catch ads that are tiring before costs climb
When a winner is fading and you need the cause and ranked ways to revive it
When the body still works and only the opening is worn out, to get ten new ones
When a winner should be rewritten for each top customer group in the same voice
Each week, to turn last week's results into a checked batch of new scripts

tasks.task: Move budget to what sells and scale safely

items.when: When a test has winners and the scale rules in the plan decide the next step
When a budget rise or a new campaign needs the client's yes first
Before scaling, to check the winner is real and not a small-sample fluke
When spend is large enough to ask whether TikTok sales would have happened anyway
When the plan doubles spend at once, to ask what a bad week would cost

tasks.task: Check ads against TikTok rules and AI-label needs

items.when: Before any ad or Spark Ad launches, to catch claim, disclosure, AI-label and teen issues
When the ad and its page both need a line-by-line policy check with safer rewrites
When a script has many claims, to sort each as fine, needs proof or cut

tasks.task: Write a change request for the client to approve

items.when: Whenever a change needs the client's yes or sits outside the agreed limits
When the request must show the bottleneck and its cause in the numbers
When the client needs each metric explained before they can say yes

tasks.task: Audit an existing TikTok ad account

items.when: When you have the account's exports and need to find where money leaks
When results changed, to test six possible causes against the account's own past
When one campaign underperforms and you need the main bottleneck named
After the audit, to set the weekly routine that keeps the fixes in place

tasks.task: Plan the edit, captions and on-screen text for video ads

items.when: When you have clips and a script and need a timed cut list and caption windows
When on-screen words must be timed and kept clear of the app's buttons
Before upload, to run the cut, the captions and a launch check in one pass
When the cut, captions and resize are done on a phone or in a browser

tasks.task: Study rival ads and what is working in the category

items.when: When you need a report on rivals' public ads and the pages they send people to
When you have winning ads and want each split into its message and its look
When you need public videos, comments and stats for a hashtag or account

tasks.task: Plan ads for a TikTok Shop

items.when: When the client sells in TikTok Shop and needs shopping ads, video ads and bids planned
When the shop moves to automated shop campaigns and needs settings and a return target
When results are in, to see which videos, creators and ads really made sales

tasks.task: Check the page each ad sends people to

items.when: When an ad gets clicks but few sales, to score how well the page matches it
When the page does not carry on from the video and needs new copy that does

tasks.task: Write the monthly results report for the client

items.when: When the report should draw on the dated test log and the weekly calls
When the client needs trends, wins, misses and what changes next
When platform numbers and store numbers disagree and must be reconciled
Before a return figure goes in the report, to test it against real sales

always.when: When a script or report states a number or result you cannot trace to the client
Before a brief, script or report is sent, to catch typos and names spelt two ways

helpers.when: When the account needs a deeper bank of concepts and a creative plan for months
When raw creator footage needs cutting into several finished versions
When creator work needs contracts, rates and a tracked programme
When the client sells in TikTok Shop and listings, affiliates and lives need running
When ads get clicks but the landing page or checkout loses the sale
When the client asks what TikTok really adds next to other channels

No library item plans TikTok app install or lead form campaigns
No library item drafts a creator contract or usage-rights terms for paid posts
No library item reads TikTok's top ads and trending sounds or picks music that may be used in ads
No library item writes a change request for client approval or sets approval levels for account changes
No library item runs a new client intake for a TikTok ad account; only the kit prompt does
